description:
Inspect Assistant

Read your chats with Vruum and the workspace's Agent work. Read-only.

- activation: no id or payload. Read current permitted company facts,
  identities, responsibilities, unknowns and registered available next reads.
  Recorded profile fields do not establish readiness or execution authority.
- shared_conversation: id=conversation UUID; optional payload={before_sequence,
  limit, eligible_after_user_id}. Read current permitted shared history and,
  for authorized inviters, a bounded current member selection page. Earlier
  private prose and revoked sources stay excluded. Vruum's answers carry
  asked_by_user_id, withheld and tool_turns (reads made, never their data);
  active_turn shows an answer in progress. This read runs no agent.
- shared_conversations: no id; optional payload={before_activity, before_id,
  limit, archived}. Shared conversations you take part in, newest activity
  first: owner, participant count, last activity, unread, attention and
  whether Vruum is answering. Metadata only, never a title or message
  text. archived=true lists the ones you archived.

- company_context: id=Job UUID; no payload. Inspect current permitted account
  context, exact source references, owned coverage gaps and typed offer-choice
  recovery. Unsupported Job scopes remain explicit; this read starts no work.
- company_understanding: no id; payload={subject: company | objective:<id> |
  account:<id>, max_chars, view: context|full, sections}. Read current strategy, offers,
  accepted decisions, customer promises, relationships and supported evidence;
  for the company subject also team_discussion, the newest messages in the
  Slack channels the workspace allowed, each with channel, time, permalink
  and author (discussion, not a decision); for the company or an account,
  meetings, the newest meeting-note summaries with their provenance.
  sections narrows the read, for example ["decisions"] for the accepted
  decisions that govern the subject; evidence also returns decisions.
  The default returns a rendering within max_chars with coverage, gaps and
  omissions; view=full adds the structured sections. Bounded or failed
  sections never read as empty.
- company_decisions: no id; optional payload={subject_key, state, limit}.
  The workspace's company decisions, newest first, with each frozen
  proposal and, once answered, its resolution. state: proposed (open),
  approved (in force), executed (superseded or revoked), rejected
  (dismissed). subject_key: company:<workspace id>, objective:<id>,
  motion:<key>, experiment:<id> or recommendation:<id>; a key that matches
  nothing returns none. A decision is a few KB, so filter and keep limit
  small. Answering a decision stays with its owner.

- practice_roles: no id or payload. Your current revenue role and ramp
  stage, and their history.
- practice_focuses: no id; optional payload={status, limit,
  before_created, before_id}. Your practice focuses (a named weakness you
  practice, or one you coach), newest first. Page with next_before.
- practice_focus: id=focus UUID; no payload. One focus and its practice
  items (the prompt, what good looks like and the real example). Coaching
  notes, observations and participation stay in the app; practice and
  notes are recorded there by people, never through this read.
- practice_applied_work: id=focus UUID; optional payload={limit,
  before_at, before_id}. The subject's real work approved after the
  focus was named, with any observations on it. Observational, never a
  score.

- list: no id; optional payload={before_updated_at, before_id, limit,
  archived}. Your chats in this workspace, newest first. For the next page
  pass the last item's updated_at and id. Each has attention (needs_you: a
  decision or Continue you have not seen; unread: an answer you have not
  seen), activity (running, awaiting_decision, interrupted), queued (a
  running chat that starts when one of your other answers finishes),
  running_since and archived_at. archived=true lists the chats you
  archived.
- attention: no id or payload. How many of your chats, private or shared
  and not archived, need you or have an unread answer, and how many of
  your own are running or queued.
- read: id=chat UUID; optional payload={before_sequence, limit}. The
  chat's messages with full text (newest page first), its turns with
  their state, and its record changes (items) with their Undo state and
  each answer's current rating. Use next_before_sequence for earlier
  messages.

- browser_source: id=snapshot UUID; optional payload={offset, link_offset, element_offset}. Read saved browser text in 12,000-character pages, links in groups of 10, and controls in groups of 20. Follow next_offset, next_link_offset and next_element_offset independently. This is private observed evidence, not browsing authority.

- jobs: no id; optional payload={scope: everyone|mine, view:
  current|history}. The workspace's Agent work as outcomes: one row per
  objective with agent work (kinds Outreach, Content, Plan inside;
  contributing objectives under their parent) or per one-off request. Each
  row has progress, what each kind is doing now, and the decisions it waits
  for: needs_you are yours to make, waiting_for names who else decides.
  Each kind's controls are the ones you may send: manage_assistant
  job_control at its revision, or, when it names a coordination_job,
  coordination_control on that Job at its revision (stop is cancel).
- job: id=row key (objective:<id> or request:<id>) or a Delegation UUID.
  The row plus what each kind was handed, the newest 20 journal entries
  (recorded facts and the agent's labelled notes) and, for a request, its
  saved steps and result (the analysis and drafts it prepared, each with
  its own approval). Every member reads it; reading never resumes work.
- responsibility: id=responsibility Action UUID; no payload. Read its current
  assignment, acknowledgment, deadlines, exact brief and owned recovery.
- responsibility_evidence: id=responsibility Action UUID; payload={expected_revision,
  assignment_generation}. Read bounded, currently permitted canonical supporting
  Evidence for the acknowledged receiver's exact assignment. Returned references
  have source-owned revisions; eligibility never proves completion or approval.
- dependencies: id=canonical Action UUID; no payload. Read its exact dependency
  bindings and currently valid registered verification proof. Reading grants
  no permission to execute or resume the dependent work.
- coordination: id=coordination Job UUID; no payload. Read its permitted brief,
  exact requirements, retained partial results and owned recovery conditions.
  Operational verification and measured business outcomes remain distinct.
- coordination_templates: no id or payload. The plan templates you can start
  with manage_assistant coordination_start: each one's id, title, summary,
  consequence and slots (JSON Schema).
- work_start: id=work_start Action UUID; no payload. Read a Vruum agent
  suggestion: its template and slots (or generic task), what the judge
  read and quoted, who it is routed to, and the Job its approval started.
- standing_approvals: no id; payload={objective_id?}. The standing
  approvals the Vruum agent starts work on, with their givers and starts.
- coordination_effect: id=effect Action UUID; no payload. Read an effect a
  coordination Step proposed (capability, summary, payload, the person or
  account it reaches, state) with the revision and payload_fingerprint that
  manage_assistant coordination_effect_decide binds. Reading decides nothing.
- conflict: id=work_conflict Action UUID; no payload. Read a decision
  between live Jobs that want the same contact or capacity: each competing
  Job, whether it holds the subject now, whether you may decide, and the
  version manage_assistant conflict_decide binds. Reading decides nothing.

A turn in state running is still working; read again for its answer.
Messages, changes and ratings are the same ones the app's chat panel
shows.

### Responses:

**200**: Successful Response (Success Response)
Content-Type: application/json

Chat with Vruum support (assistant_conversations):
Product support is not permission. Inspect current work and follow the domain's authorization and review rules.
- start_conversation: manage_assistant action=start_conversation. Start a chat with one message and wait up to 50 s for the answer. The same request UUID reaches the same chat and turn on a retry.
- append_message: manage_assistant action=append_message. Send the next message in a chat and wait the same way. One message runs at a time per chat.
- undo: manage_assistant action=undo. Undo one record change the chat applied, by its item ID. Refused when the record was edited since.
- decide_card: manage_assistant action=decide_card. Decide one pending card by its item ID: approved runs its exact call once under the caller's credentials; declined never runs it.
- rate: manage_assistant action=rate. Rate one answer up or down with optional reasons; 0 clears it.
- list: inspect_assistant action=list. Page the current member's chats in the workspace, newest first.
- read: inspect_assistant action=read. Read a chat's messages with full text, its turns, its record changes and the reader's ratings. Follow next_before_sequence.
- browser_source: inspect_assistant action=browser_source. Read the original member's saved Radar page snapshot in bounded text pages.
- sharing: inspect_assistant action=shared_conversation. The chat's owner shares chosen messages with teammates after a preview; participants read the shared conversation and ask Vruum read-only questions there. Other messages stay with their author.

action.description: The operation to perform — see the tool description for the action vocabulary and each action's id/payload semantics.
action.title: action

for_company.description: Optional company ID or name (UUID, or case-insensitive EXACT name match — partial / substring matches are NOT supported; ambiguous names raise 400) to execute this tool as. Use get_operator_companies, or get_operator_overview with view='companies', to list available companies. Only needed if you manage multiple companies. Access is enforced server-side: the tool resolves the value to a user_company_id and verifies the caller's membership in `company_users` — a 403 'Company not found or access denied' means EITHER the value did not match a known company OR the caller is not a member of it. The MCP operator role itself is NOT auto-granted — operators get this access by being members of each client company via `company_users` (the same row that grants any normal user access).
for_company.title: for_company

id.description: Target entity id, or an ARRAY of ids to apply the same action+payload to each (max 100; see the tool description for which entity the id names per action).
id.title: id

items.description: For create-like actions only: an array of per-item payloads processed in order with per-item results (max 100). Mutually exclusive with `id` and `payload`.
items.title: items

payload.description: Action-specific fields, validated by the underlying route. When the shape is unclear, fetch type=operation_contract with id='<tool>/action=<action>' for the exact nested schema; a tool-family id lists its operations. Reuse known contracts rather than fetching before every write.
payload.title: payload
